name: io.github.Mewnah/stack-and-dns-mcp
description: Inspect any domain: tech stack, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/MX email health and security posture, for AI agents

environmentVariables.name: STACKDNS_USAGE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Usage file path (default ./data/usage.json, relative to the client's working directory; absolute path recommended).

environmentVariables.name: STACKDNS_DB_FILE
environmentVariables.description: SQLite database for stored scans, bulk checks and monitoring (default ./data/stackdns.db; absolute path recommended, none disables storage).

environmentVariables.name: STACKDNS_DNS_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated DNS resolvers: ip, ipv4:port, [ipv6]:port or [ipv4]:port, port 1-65535 (optional; default: system resolvers; anything else stops startup).

environmentVariables.name: STACKDNS_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level, written to stderr (server default info; warn recommended for MCP clients).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer sdm_live_... API key, or a session token issued after an HTTP 402 payment.
